cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental, ineffable principle underlying the universe and all phenomena.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies a cosmic order that cannot be fully expressed in words.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Way that can be spoken of is not the eternal Way; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): To express or articulate something verbally.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies the act of verbal expression, often in a philosophical or didactic context.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The master speaks it, the disciple repeats it.|The Master said: Lead them by moral example and align them with ritual, and they will have shame and be upright.|A gentleman expresses his words, a petty person conceals his deeds.|The way is the path by which something comes to be.
cards.Sentences: 夫子道之，弟子述之。|子曰：道之以德，齐之以礼，有耻且格。|君子道其言，小人隐其事。|道者，言其所由也。
